# grove clone: PR GitHub CLI arguments and failures are tested offline

mkdir source
exec git init source
cd source
cp ../README.md .
exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'initial commit'
exec git checkout -b feature/pr
cp ../feature.txt .
exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'PR commit'
exec git checkout main
cd ..

env FAKE_GH_LOG=$WORK/gh.log
env FAKE_GH_REPO=file://$WORK/source
env FAKE_GH_PR_VIEW=$WORK/pr.json
exec grove clone https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/42 workspace
exists workspace/pr-42/feature.txt

env FAKE_GH_FAIL='pr view'
env FAKE_GH_EXIT=24
env FAKE_GH_STDERR='fake PR failure'
! exec grove clone https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/43 failed
stderr 'gh failed: fake PR failure'
! exists failed/.bare

# The PR clone path has its own repo clone and authentication failures.
env FAKE_GH_FAIL='repo clone'
env FAKE_GH_STDERR='fake PR clone failure'
! exec grove clone https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/44 clone-failed
stderr 'clone failed: fake PR clone failure'

env FAKE_GH_FAIL='auth status'
! exec grove clone https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/45 auth-failed
stderr 'gh not authenticated'

# A fork PR asks gh for the fork URL, then fetches from the local fixture.
env FAKE_GH_FAIL=
mkdir fork
exec git -C fork init
cp fork.txt fork/fork.txt
exec git -C fork add .
exec git -C fork commit -m 'fork commit'
exec git -C fork branch -m fork-feature
env FAKE_GH_PR_VIEW=$WORK/fork-pr.json
env FAKE_GH_REPO_VIEW=$WORK/fork-url.txt
exec grove clone https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/46 fork-workspace
exists fork-workspace/pr-46/fork.txt

cmpenv gh.log want-gh.log

-- README.md --
# Test

-- feature.txt --
PR content

-- pr.json --
{"headRefName":"feature/pr","headRepository":{"name":"widgets"},"headRepositoryOwner":{"login":"acme"}}

-- fork-pr.json --
{"headRefName":"fork-feature","headRepository":{"name":"fork"},"headRepositoryOwner":{"login":"contrib"}}

-- fork-url.txt --
file://$WORK/fork

-- fork.txt --
fork content

-- want-gh.log --
["auth","status"]
["repo","clone","acme/widgets","$WORK/workspace/.bare","--","--bare"]
["pr","view","42","--repo","acme/widgets","--json","headRefName,headRepository,headRepositoryOwner"]
["auth","status"]
["repo","clone","acme/widgets","$WORK/failed/.bare","--","--bare"]
["pr","view","43","--repo","acme/widgets","--json","headRefName,headRepository,headRepositoryOwner"]
["auth","status"]
["repo","clone","acme/widgets","$WORK/clone-failed/.bare","--","--bare"]
["auth","status"]
["auth","status"]
["repo","clone","acme/widgets","$WORK/fork-workspace/.bare","--","--bare"]
["pr","view","46","--repo","acme/widgets","--json","headRefName,headRepository,headRepositoryOwner"]
["repo","view","contrib/fork","--json","url","-q",".url"]
